summary: John's 10th-great-grandmother; widowed Huguenot matriarch who brought the Mersereau children from Moëze to New York.
bio: Elisabet Dubois made her mark ('marque X') at her son Daniel Mercereau's wedding to Suzanne Marie Doucinet at the French Church of New York on 6 Aug 1693. She is not of the Louis DuBois (Walloon, New Paltz) family; no link to any other Dubois immigrant is proven. Her parents are unknown; birth at Moëze c.1636 is speculative (WikiTree Dubois-163).
sources: Registers of the French Church of New York, Collections of the Huguenot Society of America vol. 1 (1886): https://archive.org/details/collectionsofhug01hugu pp.29-31
